name: mla_bwd
title: DeepSeek-V3 MLA attention backward (bf16, qk 192 / v 128, MHA 128 heads, causal, SBHD) on gfx1250
notes: hip/ is primus_turbo/hipkittens/gfx1250_mla_bwd/hip at Primus-Turbo d3590be4 (dev/lhz/dsv3-attn-hk-b0); patches/NN_<commit>.patch is that commit's change to hip/, so rung N's tree is the branch's hip/ at that commit.
sha256 / asm_input_sha256 / extra_flags: the commit's manifest.json; FlyDSL bwd (baseline) = 3.194 ms on the same ruler.
ref_ms: a08-1 GPU3 full backward at b2 s4096 h128 SBHD (scripts/hk/mla_ab.py), orientation only.

Rounds 1 / 2 are split into one-feature sub-rungs r1a..r1m (hk_v0 -> d18ab9fc) and r2a..r2f (d18ab9fc -> 5c20de7e), reconstructed from the scratch variants of the dsv3 hk_b0 study (x1_dkdv_sched, x2_dkdv_expert, x3_dkdv_mask, x4_dq, r2_z3_dq; reports results/hk_b0/p2_*.md, p3_z3.md). r1 = r1m byte for byte (no leftover patch); r2 = r2f + patches/02z_5c20de7e_leftover.patch (renames, comment moves, code motion of desc(), dead last-unit code; codegen neutral: r2f already builds r2's pinned sha). patches/01_d18ab9fc.patch / 02_5c20de7e.patch are the whole-commit diffs, kept for reference (applying a round's sub-patches in order gives the same tree); no rung uses them.

Sub-rung refs: dkdv numbers are paired speedups vs hk_v0 from multi_ab / pair_ab (same process, rotating order, 60 x 8192^3 GEMM prefill, GPU3 of a08-1); dq-only numbers (x4_ab / z3_ab) time k_dqds_c after the shipped delta + dkdv of that time (hk_v0 for round 1, r1 for round 2), so behind a faster dkdv they shrink (power coupling). A ref says when it was measured standalone or in another order; rungs without a matching measurement say so.

main line m02 -> m07q (written 2026-10-27, e15-02): a wider dQ wave (K^T reuse), bursts, 32 kv rows per dK / dV wave with 32-query steps, longest-first order, 64-query dQ waves. The Llama backward ladder's later steps (LD rows by TDM, pipelined softmax, barrier + readback, a deeper ring, wave kinds) measured flat on MLA at this geometry and are side rungs; hk_v0 remains a 1.4-1.5x step (48-row waves on 2-wave workgroups, export in whole lines, causal-packed dS, 384-query dQ on a K ring).

rungs.feature: naive FA2 backward with MLA dims (qk 192 / v 128, MHA): prep + dK/dV kernel + separate dQ kernel recomputing S and dP
double-buffered TDM fills (the Llama ladder's b01 + b02): 192-wide tiles as 128- and 64-column ops
dS^T exported by the dK/dV kernel to a scratch, dQ = dS K read back from it: no S/dP recompute, no atomics
dQ kernel: 32 queries per wave (128 per WG), each K^T operand feeds 2 WMMAs, a chunk's operands as one burst
dK/dV kernel: operand bursts per q tile, tr16 operands of dV / dK during the softmax, NL / delta requested a run ahead
dK/dV kernel: 32 kv rows per wave (128 per WG), 32-query steps: every Q / dO operand feeds 2 WMMAs
longest-first workgroup order in both kernels (heads fastest; kv blocks ascending, q blocks descending)
dQ kernel: 64 queries per wave (256 per WG): each K^T operand feeds 4 WMMAs, a K tile serves 256 queries

first HK backward (d3590be4): 48 kv rows per wave on 2-wave workgroups (each Q / dO operand feeds 3 WMMAs), a 3-stage Q / dO ring with per-q-tile readback, dS^T exported in whole 128-B lines (DPP regroup) to a causal-packed layout (4.33 GB), 384-query dQ workgroups on a K ring, lock_simd

dK/dV: the dS^T export (6 buffer stores) is pinned by a sched_barrier right after the dO^T tr16 burst, ahead of the first dV WMMA: without expert scheduling a store issued inside the WMMA run waits for every earlier WMMA, under the tr16 latency it is free.
rungs.ref: x12_m3 b1: paired dkdv 1.0213x (20/20), bwd 1.0152x vs hk_v0; GPU3, multi_ab 20 rounds x 50, GEMM prefill; p2_x12_dkdv_sched.md §2

rungs.feature: dK/dV: split ring barrier (hk1.h lds_arrive = release fence + s_barrier_signal, lds_wait = s_barrier_wait + acquire) with the 24 register-only dK kh1/kh2 WMMAs between arrive and wait, so the other wave's late arrival overlaps matrix work instead of an idle s_barrier.
rungs.ref: b1 + c24 not measured; c24 alone on hk_v0: x12_m4 paired dkdv 1.0190x (19/20), bwd 1.0143x; GPU3 multi_ab 20x50; p2_x12_dkdv_sched.md §2

rungs.feature: dK/dV: the full loop specialised for G == 1 (MHA: the q-pair counter is ii, the q head 0), so the clamped prefetch tiles are min(ii + k, n - 1) instead of the k1_nx_* / k1_pf_* select chains: loop-top SALU 156 -> 57 per 2 iterations (the G != 1 loop stays as a second copy).
rungs.ref: x12_m6 comb_noa (= b1 + c24 + d, this rung's source): paired dkdv 1.0319x (20/20), bwd 1.0239x vs hk_v0; GPU3 multi_ab 20x50; p2_x12_dkdv_sched.md §2

rungs.feature: dK/dV: the 8 NL/ND loads put their constant on the VGPR offset (3 loop-invariant VGPRs) and share one SGPR soffset, so no SALU rewrites an address register that an in-flight buffer load still reads (the s_wait_xcnt 0 WAR stalls go).
rungs.ref: x12_m7 comb_a (= this rung's source): paired dkdv 1.0752x (16/16), bwd 1.0534x vs hk_v0; GPU3 multi_ab 16x40; p2_x12_dkdv_sched.md §2

rungs.feature: dK/dV: the dS^T export first regroups all 3 blocks into distinct staging VGPRs (24 DPP ops), then issues the 6 stores, so no store-data register is rewritten while an earlier store still reads it (the ~82-cyc store-data s_wait_xcnt goes; with r1d the full loop has no s_wait_xcnt left).
rungs.ref: x12_m8 x1s (= this rung; sha pinned from x1_dkdv_sched/best/manifest.json): paired dkdv 1.0860x (16/16), bwd 1.0604x vs hk_v0 (x12_m7: 1.0860x / 1.0608x); GPU3 multi_ab 16x40; p2_x12_dkdv_sched.md §0, §2

rungs.feature: dK/dV compiled with -amdgpu-expert-scheduling-mode: the compiler places explicit s_wait_alu va_vdst / vm_vsrc counts instead of relying on the hardware interlock, so DS / VMEM issue no longer waits for every earlier WMMA.
rungs.ref: x12_m8 x2s (= this rung; sha pinned from x2_dkdv_expert/best/manifest.json): paired dkdv 1.1192x (14/16), bwd 1.0807x vs hk_v0; merge_pairs1 'x12': dkdv 1.1239x, bwd 1.0848x (10/10, pair_ab 10x40); p2_x12_dkdv_sched.md §4.1, p2_merge_r1.md §4.2

rungs.feature: dK/dV: the masked (diagonal) iterations ride the full loop's 3-stage Q/dO TDM ring with prefetch distance 2 (tile j in stage (j - n_mask) mod 3, k3m_idx.h) instead of an own-tile TDM + tensorcnt 0 + 2 barriers each: ~3 exposed HBM round trips (~1.2k cyc) per 96-row workgroup and 4 barriers per wave go.
rungs.ref: merge_pairs1 'mdk' (= this rung: r1 dkdv + hk_v0 dq): paired dkdv 1.1331x, bwd 1.0912x vs hk_v0 (10/10); x12 -> x12+x3 paired dkdv 1.0082x (10/10); GPU3 pair_ab 10x40 GEMM prefill; p2_merge_r1.md §4.2. On hk_v0 alone: x3_m_v1_v1a_r20 v1a dkdv 1.0191x (18/20), p2_x3_dkdv_mask.md §3.2

rungs.feature: dQ: split barrier P_{u+1} in every steady unit but the last: arrive (tensorcnt 1, dscnt 0, release, s_barrier_signal) after WMMA 48 of run(X) (32 on the head tile), wait after run(X), so the remaining WMMAs absorb the ~90-cyc lag of the dS-issuing waves 0 / 3.
rungs.ref: dq only, measured on hk_v0 dkdv: x4_ab_il1 s48 dq 0.5298 -> 0.5096 ms, 1.0396x (5/5); x4_ab_split_sweep 1.040x; GPU3 x4_ab (dq event time after shipped delta + dkdv, 5 rounds); p2_x4_dq.md §3, §3.1

rungs.feature: dQ compiled with -amdgpu-expert-scheduling-mode: a DS read no longer waits for earlier WMMAs (the prerequisite of r1j's interleave).
rungs.ref: dq only: x4_ab_il1 exs48 1.0507x (5/5) vs hk_v0 dq; p2_x4_dq.md §3

rungs.feature: dQ: in main-tile steady units the 36-tr16 operand bursts are interleaved into the WMMA runs with sched_group_barrier ({8 WMMA} then {1 tr16, 1 WMMA} x 36 before the arrive, {4 WMMA} then the same under run(Y)), hiding the 130-180-cyc bursts under matrix work.
rungs.ref: dq only: x4_ab_il1 il48 1.0669x (5/5) vs hk_v0 dq; p2_x4_dq.md §3, §3.4

rungs.feature: dQ: the split-barrier arrive moves from WMMA 48 to 66 (44 on the head tile): region A now carries the whole interleaved Y burst, and the later arrive lets its 36 tr16 retire before the s_wait_dscnt 0 that precedes the signal.
rungs.ref: dq only: x4_ab_fin1 il66 1.0783x (8/8) (x4_ab_il2 1.072x, x4_ab_me 1.082x) vs hk_v0 dq; the rebuilt sha starts with c8856d2e, the 8-hex prefix recorded for x4_dq/best_il66 (p2_x4_dq.md §6; too short to pin)

rungs.feature: dQ: the masked units' zero-select predicate in branch-free form (x4_ds_zero: | instead of ||), so the selects compile to in-place v_cndmask instead of 17 scalar branches + v_dual_mov operand copies that split the scheduling region (VGPR 887 -> 871).
rungs.ref: dq only: x4_ab_fin1 il66ms 1.0847x (8/8) vs hk_v0 dq; p2_x4_dq.md §3.5

rungs.feature: dQ: the masked units (all but the last) take the split barrier too, with the select pattern carried in the first part of run(X).
rungs.ref: dq only: x4_ab_fin1 il66mms (= x4 best, sha pinned) 1.0876x (8/8) vs hk_v0 dq; x4_g_best_b2 variant_ab 5x30: bwd 1.013x, dq 0.5249 -> 0.4796 ms; behind the r1 dkdv (power coupling) merge_pairs1 'merged': dq 1.0512x, bwd 1.1023x vs hk_v0; p2_x4_dq.md §3, §4, p2_merge_r1.md §4.2

rungs.feature: round 1: dK/dV scheduling (dS export placement, split barrier, MHA loop top, NL/ND voffsets), masked tiles on the TDM ring, dQ split barrier / tr16 interleave / branch-free masks; expert scheduling for both

dQ: in masked units a wave-uniform branch per q pair skips a fully masked pair's WMMAs instead of selecting its B operand to zero (bitwise identical: those WMMAs only add +-0), so the selects and the masked pairs' WMMA issue (and energy) go.
rungs.ref: dq only vs r1 dq: z3_ab1 skip 1.029x (5/5); GPU3 z3_ab (dq event time after shipped delta + dkdv, 5 rounds, blocks of 2); p3_z3.md §3, §3.2

rungs.feature: dQ: the epilogue runs per 16-row sub-tile through a private 16 x 400 B per-wave LDS image after the rings (LDS 276480 -> 302080, still 1 WG/CU) instead of the whole-wave image in the dead ring: shorter store / load chains, epilogue 3.1 -> 2.4 us per WG.
rungs.ref: z3_ab2 se (= r2a + this): 1.026x (5/5) vs r1 dq (epilogue alone: z3_ab1 1.014x, z3_ab2 1.005x); p3_z3.md §3, §3.4

rungs.feature: dQ: the steady loop's (REAL) TDM descriptors drop the runtime nv >= 1 check (a real unit's rows always hold a stored pair), so the descriptor SALU inside the WMMA run needs no select / branch that would split burst Y and run X into different basic blocks.
rungs.ref: not measured on its own (z3_ab2 rgk = this + keep_ds without the unroll: 0.995x); p3_z3.md §3.3

rungs.feature: dQ: main-tile steady loop unrolled by the ring depth (3), so every stage index is a compile-time constant: the burst addresses become precomputed base VGPRs + immediates and the loop carries no VALU, which lets expert mode count va_vdst(k) waits instead of va_vdst(0) drains.
rungs.ref: not measured in this order; the unroll without keep_ds on r1: z3_ab1 u3 0.992x / u3b 0.995x (0/5) -- it regresses (register reuse, 11 va_vdst(0) per 3 units) until r2e; p3_z3.md §3.3

rungs.feature: dQ: keep_ds() (an empty asm volatile taking the 6 dS operands) keeps each region's dS operands live to its end, so the next burst cannot be allocated to a register the newest WMMA just read (that WAR forced va_vdst(0)).
rungs.ref: z3_ab2 u3kse (= this rung) 1.0406x (5/5) vs r1 dq; p3_z3.md §3

rungs.feature: dQ: q pairs dealt to the waves in snake order {w, 7 - w, 8 + w} (head {w, 7 - w}) instead of contiguous blocks, so the fully masked pairs of the diagonal units spread over all 4 waves (skippable share per wave 83% / 8% -> 42-50%) and the barrier-bound masked critical path drops by a third.
rungs.ref: z3_ab2 u3ksse (= this rung) 1.053x (5/5), z3_ab3 1.0658x (5/5); delivered source (sha pinned from r2_z3_dq/best/manifest.json) z3_ab10 1.064x (8/8); z3_gc_b2 variant_ab 7x30: bwd 1.0098x (7/7), dq 0.4995 -> 0.4693 ms; p3_z3.md §0, §3

rungs.feature: dQ round 2: snake q pairs, masked-pair skip, steady loop unrolled by the ring depth, per-sub-tile epilogue image
dK/dV compiler knobs: bottom-up pre-RA scheduling, delay-alu off, no machine sink
dK/dV: Q^T loads interleaved into the dV run + asm register retarget (va_vdst(0) drains 15 -> 9 per 2 iterations)
HIP k_delta (several b128 loads in flight per lane)
hardening: s_wait_xcnt before the tail block reuses its K/V descriptor SGPRs (perf-neutral)
redundant causal test dropped from the masked dK/dV loop
flat on MLA (1.00x): q steps descending, FULL steps without the mask, wave kinds on the diagonal -- the mask is a smaller share of a 6-k-step S tile, at 966 VGPRs
flat on MLA (side): NL / delta rows by TDM with the step's Q / dO tiles (the Llama ladder's b07l; 1.00x)
flat on MLA (side): q tile 1's S / dP WMMAs || q tile 0's softmax, co-execution scheduler (0.99x; by kv tile: 0.98x)
m07l + the 64-query dQ waves of m07q
negative on MLA (side): 2-wave dK / dV workgroups (64 kv rows; 0.97x: twice the Q / dO staging per kv row)
flat on MLA (side): step barrier between the dV and dK runs, the next step's first operands + NL / delta read back under the dK WMMAs (1.00x)
flat on MLA (side): 3-slot Q / dO ring, TDM ops two steps ahead (1.00x)

baselines.note: Primus-Turbo's FlyDSL gfx1250 MLA backward (primus_turbo.flydsl.attention.gfx1250_mla.bwd) behind bwd_hk's SBHD folding
